_note: NOTAMs read for a pilot, the engine's notam_read (engine/crates/weather/src/notam_read): each in the form FAA Order JO 7930.2's examples give it (Appendix A; the paragraph in each case's about), with Oshkosh's places and times. Each title names the thing its subject's words say (the words after the keyword), null where they name none; its what, where and why in our words, null where its subject's words do not say them, each why a settled rule or a plain fact (AIM 1-1-9, 2-1-2, 5-1-3; JO 7340.2's CLSD and NA). The words are worked by hand from the order: its contractions written out (JO 7340.2, TBL 3-3-1), feet MSL unless AGL is stated (4-2-1), times UTC (3-3-2). engine/facade/tests/notam_read.rs asks the engine each case.
